**Is this already listed in `CONTRIBUTING.md#known-gaps`?**
Check there first — if it's already planned, feel free to comment on this issue with your
use case instead of re-describing the feature from scratch.

**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the situation this doesn't currently handle well, not just the feature itself.

**Proposed approach (optional)**
If you have a specific implementation in mind, sketch it here. See
[`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) first if it touches the scheduler or
the API contract — some things that look simple (e.g., "just make the scheduler greedy for
speed") have already been deliberately ruled out for stated reasons.

**Alternatives considered**
